name: GitHub
about: repos, Actions, issues and pull requests

key.name: GH_TOKEN
key.label: Access token
steps: On the pre-filled form, check the **Resource owner**.
Under **Repository access**, select **All repositories**.
Select **Generate token** (again if asked), then copy the token.

name: Cloudflare
about: Workers, D1, R2, DNS and email

key.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
key.label: API token
steps: Select **Create Token**, then the **Read All Resources** template.
Change its permissions from **Read** to **Edit** where available.
Select **Continue to summary** > **Create Token**, then copy the token.

key.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
key.label: Access token
steps: Type a token name.
Under **Scope**, select **Full Account**.
Choose an expiration, select **Create**, then copy the token.

key.name: SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN
key.label: Access token
steps: Select **Generate new token** > **Create legacy token**.
Type a name and set **Expires in** to **Never**.
Select **Generate token**, then copy the token.

name: Stripe
about: payments, in test and live mode

key.name: STRIPE_TEST_SECRET_KEY
key.label: Test secret key
key.goal: Copy your Stripe test secret key
key.note: No sk_test_ key there? Open the account picker and switch to a sandbox.
steps: Under **Standard keys**, find **Secret key** and reveal it if hidden.
Select the key (sk_test_…) to copy it.

key.name: STRIPE_TEST_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
key.label: Test publishable key
key.goal: Copy your Stripe test publishable key
steps: Under **Standard keys**, copy the **Publishable key** (pk_test_…).

key.name: STRIPE_LIVE_SECRET_KEY
key.label: Live secret key
key.goal: Create a Stripe live secret key
steps: Select **Create secret key** and type the verification code.
Type a **Key name**, then select **Create**.
Select the key (sk_live_…) to copy it.

key.name: STRIPE_LIVE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
key.label: Live publishable key
key.goal: Copy your Stripe live publishable key
key.note: Shows pk_test_? Switch from sandbox mode to live mode first.
steps: Under **Standard keys**, copy the **Publishable key** (pk_live_…).

key.name: POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY
key.label: Personal API key
steps: Select **Create key**; the form is already filled in.
Copy the key (phx_…) from the dialog.

key.name: NOTION_API_KEY
key.label: Access token
steps: Select **New token** and name it.
Choose the workspace, **Notion API**, and an expiration.
Select **Create token**, then copy the token.

name: Gmail
about: an inbox agents read and send from

key.name: GMAIL_USER
key.label: Mailbox address
key.goal: Type the Gmail address agents will use

key.name: GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD
key.label: App password
key.note: Needs 2-Step Verification turned on for that Google Account.
steps: Type a name under **App name**, then select **Create**.
Copy the 16-character password.

name: Google
about: Ads keyword research and Search Console

key.name: GOOGLE_ADS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
key.label: Ads service account key
key.goal: Save a Google Ads service account key
key.prompt: Drag or paste the key file
key.note: Its email needs access in Google Ads: Admin > Access and security.
steps: Pick your Ads project; open its service account, or create one.
Open it, then **Keys** > **Add key** > **Create new key** > **JSON** > **Create**.
Drag the downloaded .json file here, or paste what is in it.

key.name: GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
key.label: Search service account
key.goal: Save a Search Console service account key
key.prompt: Drag or paste the key file
key.note: Its email needs property access: Settings > Users and permissions.
steps: Pick your Search project; open its service account, or create one.
Open it, then **Keys** > **Add key** > **Create new key** > **JSON** > **Create**.
Drag the downloaded .json file here, or paste what is in it.

key.name: HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY_ID
key.label: API key ID
key.note: The copy holds the ID and the secret; this entry keeps the ID.
steps: Select **Create API key**, name it, then select **Create key**.
Select **Copy API key** and keep the dialog open.

key.name: HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY_SECRET
key.label: API key secret
key.goal: Paste the same Higgsfield API key again
key.note: Keeps the part after the colon. Dialog closed? New key, then redo the ID.

key.name: ZERNIO_API_KEY
key.label: API key
steps: Open **API Keys**, then select **Create API key**.
Name the key, select **Create key**, then copy it.

key.name: PRODIGI_SANDBOX_API_KEY
key.label: Sandbox API key
key.goal: Copy your Prodigi sandbox API key
key.note: pwinty.com is Prodigi's sandbox; sign in with your Prodigi account.
steps: Under **API authentication**, select **Show key** and copy it.

key.name: PRODIGI_API_KEY
key.label: Live API key
key.goal: Copy your Prodigi live API key
key.note: Orders placed with this key are printed, shipped and billed.
steps: Under **API authentication**, select **Show key** and copy it.
